title: Logging maintenance
description: Record services and repairs as they happen.

steps.text: Open the Log tab and tap Add Service/Log.
Pick what you did — oil, impeller, repair, etc.
Save. It appears in service history and cost insights.

tips: A complete history helps resale value.
Overdue intervals update after related services.
affects: Season stats, Year in Review, and the fuel-range brain.
examples: Logging an oil change with cost and date.
